trap.label: ordem das palavras
trap.wrong: Albeit it was modest, trust rose.
trap.why: Em português “embora fosse modesto”; albeit não é seguido de oração completa, só adjetivo, advérbio ou sintagma.

fix.wrong: Much as I admiring her, I disagree.
fix.right: Much as I admire her, I disagree.

fix.wrong: Albeit slowly it grew, trust rose.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com albeit: “Trust rose, although it was modest.”
Reescreva com much as: “Although I admire her, I disagree.”
rewrite.answer: Much as I admire her, I disagree.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no passado: “Much as I admire her, I disagree.”
rewrite.answer: Much as I admired her, I disagreed.
